entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments: ¶Oh come, let us sing to the LORD! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 95:2
segments: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving; Let us shout joyfully to Him with psalms.

entries.title: Psalms 95:3
segments: For the LORD [is] the great God, And the great King above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
segments: In His hand [are] the deep places of the earth; The heights of the hills [are] His also.

entries.title: Psalms 95:5
segments: The sea [is] His, for He made it; And His hands formed the dry [land].

entries.title: Psalms 95:6
segments: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments: ¶For He [is] our God, And we [are] the people of His pasture, And the sheep of His hand. Today, if you will hear His voice:

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: "Do not harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, As [in] the day of trial in the wilderness,

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
segments: When your fathers tested Me; They tried Me, though they saw My work.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: For forty years I was grieved with [that] generation, And said, 'It [is] a people who go astray in their hearts, And they do not know My ways.'

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments: So I swore in My wrath, 'They shall not enter My rest.'"
